title: Resolve identities without hiding absence or ambiguity
statement: The Engineering model storage Module shall resolve a requested identity to a unique entity reference in the selected model state only when the inspected scope establishes uniqueness, and shall distinguish absence, ambiguity, and inability to inspect that scope.

what.problem: An arbitrary match or false absence can misdirect every dependent engineering relationship.
what.desired_outcome: A caller obtains an unambiguous state-scoped designation or an honest unresolved outcome.

why.rationale: SR-002 requires identity-based designation to distinguish entities regardless of display labels.

conditions: A caller requests an entity by its stable identity.

how.approach: Resolve interpreted identity-bearing content in the selected state and qualify the result by inspection scope.

how_much.scope: One selected governed model/state at a time; no display-name fallback or cross-state substitution.

acceptance_criteria: A unique match returns its stable identity reference and selected state.
No match in completely inspected scope returns absence; multiple matching entities return ambiguity without selecting one.
Unavailable, unsupported, partial, or failed inspection does not return a false absence or unique match.
Changing display names or physical locations does not change the identity-based designation of the same entity.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-002 for the proposed MOD-001 responsibility and IR-001 scenario walkthrough. Acceptance criteria are intended observations, not executed verification or an approval.
